answer: A delta of per-task receipts records who did what, and the reef of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The knoll of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
